==Objectives==
Collect 10 Raptor Eggs and bring them to [[Grovug Mithrilmane]] stationed in Dun Agrath.
*[[Raptor Egg]]: 0/10
==Description==
Report after report of raptors slowly moving against our digsite were ignored by that fool Grovug up in the mountains.

He's had a comfy posting up in Dun Agrath and hasn't moved an inch, even though he's supposed to be here.

I need some solid proof to give to him, right to his face for some action to get done. Raptor Eggs should do finely.

Slay the beasts down there, and collect eggs from them. Bring those eggs to Grovug in the mountains of Dun Agrath to the south west along the mountains.

==Rewards==
*2150 [[XP]]
*200 Reputation with [[Ironforge]]
==Progress==
I'm on important League business up here.
==Completion==
You're saying these are from the Whelgar site? Really?

I thought they were all overreacting down there, but if it's as bad as you say then I'm going to have to write a report and get it to Ironforge as quickly as I can!
